title: an inline edit script naming the Vec append method is refused by the hook
body: The worker hook refuses any Bash command whose text holds the word for sending a branch upstream, even inside a heredoc of Rust code (a Vec method call trips it); make code edits with the Edit tool, not an inline script.

title: A skills file moves tests/init.rs bundle counts
body: A new file under skills/ raises the bundle count hard-coded in tests/init.rs (lines 130, 208, 387: `N files`); bump all three with it.

title: closeout events.jsonl parse flakes under load
body: `a_flaky_check_red_after_its_rerun_blocks_and_the_answer_resumes_at_the_pr` (tests/closeout.rs) went red once under the full parallel `cargo test` at the `events.jsonl` parse (`:73`, a half-written line) and passed 3/3 alone and on the next full run: rerun before chasing it.

title: after slice-02
body:
**Covers:** slices 01, 02
**Gate:** 1 runs, 0 red, 1.9 min — caught: nothing
**Prove:** FR-2 (preflight half), FR-6 and FR-7 were driven against the lane's 0.11.0 build in scratch repos. FR-1, FR-2's `/deliver` half, FR-3, FR-4 and FR-5 were checked by reading the rewritten skill passages against each Acceptance. The live-session proof for those rows comes on the owner's next feature after the merge. Evidence: cp-1/fr2-preflight-test.txt, cp-1/fr2-preflight-unsliced.txt, cp-1/fr6-blast-radius.txt, cp-1/fr7-ada.txt, cp-1/fr7-noname.txt, cp-1/skill-passages.txt, cp-1/inner-loop.log
**Fixed:** leaks: tests/preflight.rs:186. The expected refusal is now built from `harness::FEATURE`, not a literal plan id. The inner loop is green.

title: Relock 0.11.0 for the polish skill fixes, or bump again?
body:
**Chose:** restore `skills/bundle.lock` to the default branch's copy (0.10.0) and relock with `FACTORY_BUNDLE_WRITE=1 cargo test`, so the polish skill-text fixes ship under the same unreleased 0.11.0.
**Over:** a second bump to 0.11.1. `relock` refuses a bundle change under an unchanged version, and the slice planned one bump.
**Because:** 0.11.0 is untagged, so no released bundle changes; the lock now reads as one 0.10.0 → 0.11.0 change, the same as if slice-02 had carried these edits.
**Undo:** bump Cargo.toml to 0.11.1 and relock.

title: Where do /deliver's own commits land when it starts on the default branch?
body:
**Chose:** `/deliver` §1 step 0 runs `factory docs status NNN` first and, on the default branch, switches to the branch it names before doctor, `/slice` or a refusal fix commits anything; the slice files are committed right after `/slice`.
**Over:** committing on whatever branch the session is on and letting `ensure_branch` switch later, which leaves the slice, docs and chore commits on the default branch.
**Because:** the PRD has `/prd` commit on `feat/{slug}`, FR-4 accepts a chore commit riding in the feature PR, and FR-2 says `/deliver` writes and commits the slices.
**Undo:** drop the switch sentence from `skills/deliver/SKILL.md` §1 step 0.

title: Does a skill reload itself after updating its own file?
body:
**Chose:** after `factory skills update` rewrites the running skill's own `SKILL.md`, the skill is invoked again with the Skill tool, same arguments, from step 0 (`skills/_shared/stale-tooling.md`).
**Over:** carrying on with the old text already loaded, which can name verbs or exit codes the new binary changed.
**Because:** the update exists to bring the text in line with the binary; following the stale copy for a whole run defeats it. The second pass sees `current` and does nothing.
**Undo:** delete that paragraph from `skills/_shared/stale-tooling.md`.
